memory.summary:
On December 17th, Andy initiated various discussions regarding their musical collaboration for the AI project. They invited Samantha for a coffee meeting at Caroline's Café after their respective gym workouts and made plans to catch up with Diego beforehand. Andy also proposed a coffee meeting with Leo about the collaboration the next day, which Leo agreed to. In an unexpected encounter at a library on the same day, Andy discussed the integration of music into their AI project with Peter and invited Noor to join the conversation. They agreed to meet for discussions at Caroline's Café the following day, followed by vegan street tacos.

During a gym encounter on the same day, Andy also discussed plans for the community garden and zine club with Mei. They agreed to meet at Caroline's Café next Friday, December 23rd, at noon for a proper catch-up, and continue the musical discussion over at the park on Saturday, December 24th, around lunchtime. Andy also suggested that Mei bring her thermos of tea to their park meeting.
